gates.rule: Accepted Phase 5D price-blind modules and goldens remain byte-frozen.
authorization transitioned_at is no later than request_started_at, which is no later than retrieved_at.
Only one primary common class quoted in the reporting currency is eligible.
Quote is the official unadjusted close from the latest completed regular session on or before cutoff.
Only the unique current unconsumed v4 authorization may begin a provider request.
The orchestrator owns both timestamps, invokes one registered adapter exactly once, and never retries or falls back.
Invalid responses produce no Receipt and retain only a SHA-256 plus registered issue codes in the research core.
Provider, exact adapter class, raw parser, calendar dataset, and secret policy match component-lock 1.1.0.
Ticker, MIC, share class, and structure derive only from cutoff-safe reviewed evidence and replay exactly before access.
Only the pinned parser interprets raw bytes and accepts canonical finite positive decimal text.
Audit independently rehashes and regenerates authority resources without using production loaders as its sole oracle.
Exactly MarketReferenceSnapshot advances to closed Schema 2.0.0; v1 is rejected and the total public Schema count remains 43.
The validated Snapshot binds and replays the exact v4 Handoff, governed Request/Receipt, authority, calendar, security, and raw-response identities.
Canonical decimal strings exactly round-trip quote, quote-date fully diluted shares, split factor one, and currency-unit market equity.
Market-evidence closure and Snapshot self-fingerprint replay independently, and one v4 authorizes at most one Snapshot.

Included, excluded, and blocked option roots, the denominator lineage, bridge role, and consumption records are recomputed from the frozen Phase 5C readiness; callers cannot provide the final root set.
Draft 2020-12 Schema and Python construction reject every zero or noncanonical decimal and accept the same strictly positive domain.
Component-lock 1.2.0 replays the immutable rc.2 annotated tag object, peeled target, package, Plugin, release artifacts, and eight public Schema hashes.
Exactly MarketReferenceSnapshot advances to closed Schema 3.0.0; v2 and every fully diluted field are rejected while the public Schema count remains 43.
Quote-date current common shares replay through direct point-in-time, issued less treasury, or completed-event roll-forward evidence only.
Phase 5C included claims route specialist, blocked claims block, excluded claims remain separate bridge claims, and no claim root enters current-share numeric lineage.
Market equity and the future request-v2 witness use the same canonical current-common-share Fact and exact Decimal product.
Every current-share path terminates in exact-security, raw, formal, high-confidence, cutoff-safe numeric roots; nested authorized, reserved, or potential aliases are rejected.
Roll-forwards close all activity categories with completed official-source search receipts, never infer zero from silence, and reconcile completed claim transitions.
Only common_shares_repurchased_completed is registered; the legacy repurched spelling is rejected.
The production compiler emits quote-date current common shares through one registered evidence path.
Callers cannot submit the quote date, Fact, evidence path, status, or ShareBasisDecision.
Every eligible evidence path agrees before direct, issued-less-treasury, roll-forward precedence is applied.
The compiler strictly reloads the price-blind artifact and replays security, governed access, dilution, restatement, and evidence authorities.
The compiler is absent from package root, CLI, implicit Skills, writers, market evidence, final request, and kernel execution.
Fact, document, locator, and retrieval identities never substitute for the reviewed legal or economic share-event identity.
All corroborating formal evidence remains in one canonical group while the roll-forward and claim transition each consume the event once.
Magnitude, date, concept, security, grain, or legal-identity ambiguity blocks the numeric lineage without source-priority selection.
The corrective policy PR records and reproduces the baseline P0, prohibits Phase 5E-2C, and adds no production grouping or market-evidence surface.
Every canonical event Fact has all and only corroborating raw event Facts as parents and retains the reserved identity-derived Fact ID.
One issuer/security/official-legal-ID/effective-date occurrence cannot split into multiple canonical groups when a reviewed economic-event key drifts.

A reserved canonical Fact ID may resolve only to the byte-exact Fact independently derived by its bound materialization authority; caller-rewritten bindings are rejected and the reserved output-share Fact ID must be unoccupied.
The current-share roll-forward has all and only opening plus canonical event Facts as direct parents and consumes each group once.
Coverage category, raw-member union, source receipts, and Claim transition replay from the exact canonical group set.
Each of twelve categories appears exactly once; every N/A entry has its own category/security-specific Candidate, named-human Decision, and exact Claim projection with governed period-safe support.
Only completed option exercises use the frozen standard Phase 5C Claim authority; completed convertible and warrant transitions require a specialist route and cannot be generalized to option roots.
Bundle SourceDocuments and nested security Fact, source, and object identities reject duplicate cardinality hidden by set equality.

Every typed coverage object matches the graph-owned Bundle closure by ID and fingerprint; N/A support and counterevidence are direct-Fact-only and Candidate-safe, the Candidate is dated from the coverage period end through cutoff, and its review is no later than cutoff.

Every transition evidence Fact period and SourceDocument publication is no later than its Candidate and cutoff; every Candidate/Decision/Claim is an exact cutoff-safe projection; and every typed transition object is byte-bound to the graph-owned Bundle closure.

Code identity binds exact source bytes; the semantic oracle executes the closed case registry; and a second full JUnit run matches the exact independently collected node-ID count and hash with no skips or failures.

The initial credential-partitioned gate bootstrap is independently audited and externally reviewed without claiming retroactive self-certification. Candidate execution receives no Actions/environment secret or private-kernel credential; protected Controller and kernel jobs use separate environment-scoped GitHub Apps and never execute candidate code. The Kernel Reader App is installed only on the pinned kernel repository with exactly contents:read and metadata:read, and its short-lived token is verified before checkout. Once base-owned, the gate classifies every same-repository main PR, freezes the full pending trust root, and validates one direct two-file acceptance commit plus exact remote evidence. The 2B verifier, trust snapshot, semantic oracle, and gate tests are preinstalled and byte-locked; the exact 2B branch cannot install or modify its own judge.
A synchronously changed Security Decision, result, and grouping is rejected unless ticker, MIC, class, structure, and deterministic identity replay from current formal evidence.

Claim-transition authority is re-derived from the exact full price-blind freeze and current validated ContractGraph, preserves each reviewed root-to-economic-claim key, blocks a multi-root Claim without one graph-owned aggregate opening balance, and requires exactly one Candidate, named-human Decision, and Claim per transition.

The current component lock, graph-owned Bundle/RunManifest, one unique current unsuperseded adjacent v1-v4 Handoff run, and every Phase 5C root Fact/formal Source/Candidate/named-human Decision/Claim replay; synchronized artifact/Handoff resigns, stale runs, and graph-external roots are rejected.

Typed Phase 5C Candidate, Decision, and Claim arrays have unique identities and exact binding cardinality; every closed consumption root/key/identity resolves to its reviewed binding and each excluded option root has only its exact bridge deduction.
CurrentShareBundleEvidenceClosure replays the full authority against its own validation graph and rejects a previously valid authority transplanted from another graph.
The graph fingerprint covers only the exact governed dependency objects plus component lock; unrelated historical objects do not change the Bundle closure SHA.

Acyclic numeric lineage contains only the registered exact parent edges, terminates at opening and corroborating raw roots, and binds a target-typed transitive Bundle evidence set without cross-domain ID inference.
The opening common-share root is a raw high-confidence Fact from an official primary source; the derived output points to that same official SourceDocument and remains high confidence.
Internal immutable records and red tests add no production builder, package-root, CLI, Skill, market-evidence, request, writer, or kernel surface.
Only split factor one is eligible; every other factor routes specialist_required.
Market equity is derived exactly from the governed quote and share basis.
Existing Facts, assumption entries, price-blind input, and protected hashes remain unchanged.
The complete request validates against every pinned kernel Schema and contains no weighting field.
Only the verified pinned wheel executes in a network-disabled subprocess.
Kernel result canonical bytes are validated and preserved without research-layer modification.
Equivalent inputs replay byte-identically and unrelated history cannot change selection or hashes.
Exact-head audit reports P0=P1=P2=P3=0 before Phase 5F authorization.
